evidence.claim: The authenticated route-group layout mounts one strict StarCi theme boundary, desktop topbar, collapsible desktop rail, mobile navigation owner and routed main body.
Console navigation owns the complete grouped destination set, selected route, expanded and compact ListBox presentations, persisted collapsible rail and mobile right-edge drawer.
SelectionList preserves one HeroUI ListBox owner while expanded labels and compact circular icon targets share selected, focus and keyboard behavior; the first destination group stays pinned.
DrawerBranch owns right-edge placement, backdrop, focus, dismissal and the single drawer body.
Interaction tests prove seven destinations, disabled routes, compact icon presentation, collapse control, the complete mobile drawer and locale-aware activation.
CollapsibleRail owns one stable desktop motion host, persisted 256px and 64px states, reduced-motion behavior, invariant inset, accessible toggle and safe storage fallback.
